component.name: Peersus
component.summary: Share files and clipboard between your devices

description.p: Peersus sends files and folders between devices you have paired, on the same network or across the internet. Pairing is done once, by a code and by choosing the same numbered circle on both devices; a paired device is remembered and can be sent to again in one step.

ul.li: Sends files and whole folders to one paired device or to several at once, and shows every transfer with its progress
Pairs devices by a code that is typed or read by a camera, confirmed on both devices, and never pairs a device just because a file was sent
Keeps every connection between devices authenticated and encrypted, with an identity kept in the system keyring
Works between computers and Android phones
Can keep running in the background to receive while its window is closed

description.p: Extensions add what the application itself does not do, such as sharing the clipboard. Each is a separate program installed on request, shows its licence and what it changes before it is installed, and can only do what you have allowed it on each device. Nothing is installed with the application.
The programs it installs, each with one job:

ul.li: peersus-ui: the window, which only shows what the core reports and passes on what you do
peersus: the core, which keeps the devices, the transfers, the settings and the extensions, also with no window open; its command line controls a running core
peersus-wasm-host, peersus-wasm-canvas-host and peersus-native-host: run one extension each apart from the core; only the canvas WASM host includes a renderer
peersus-store-fetch: fetches the signed list of extensions and their packages, and nothing else

description.p: Development prerelease: not published, and not yet a version to rely on.
